header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: is one: to do the Dhikr of Allah abundantly in gatherings.” Hazrat Sahl ibn Hunaif (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ:قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ:مَا مِنْ رَاكِبٍ يَخْلُو فِي مَسِيرِهِ بِاللهِ وَذِكْرِهِ إِلَّا رَدِفَهُ مَلَكٌ وَلَا يَخْلُو بِشِعْرٍ وَنَحْوِهِ إِلَّا رَدِفَهُ شَيْطَانٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني واسناده حسن مجمع الزوائد:١٠ /١٨٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “If any traveller, during his journey, withdraws from worldly affairs and remains absorbed in the remembrance of Allah, an angel joins him. If he is engaged in useless poetry (or) unnecessary matters, Shaytan joins him.” Hazrat Uqbah ibn Amir (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text:
عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَي ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لَا يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ.
وفي رواية لمسلم مَثَلُ الْبَيْتِ الَّذِي يُذْكَرُ اللهُ فِيهِ وَالْبَيْتِ الَّذِي لَا يُذْكَرُ اللهُ فِيهِ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic:
رواه البخاري باب فضل ذكر الله رقم: ٦٤٠٧
باب استحباب صلاة النافلة في بيته ...رقم:١٨٢٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Musa (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “The example of one who does the Dhikr of Allah and one who does not do Dhikr is like that of the living and the dead. The one who does Dhikr is like the living, and the one who does not do Dhikr is like the dead.” In another narration, “The house in which Allah is remembered is like the living (flourishing), and the house in which Allah is not remembered is like the dead (desolate),” it
